description: Satellite imagery, likely a false-colour infrared composite, displaying a mixed landscape in Stockholm, Sweden, credited to K. Larsson. The image illustrates the Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) Land Cover class 1210, "Road network and its associated land", which is highlighted in light blue. The upper portion of the image shows dense urban or peri-urban areas, characterised by blueish-grey patterns of buildings and streets. A prominent road network, including a bridge crossing a river and a motorway interchange, is outlined in light blue, indicating the feature being classified as 1210. The river itself appears dark blue/green. The lower and right-hand portions of the image show large areas of vegetation, likely agricultural fields, appearing in vibrant red hues characteristic of infrared imagery, interspersed with some lighter grey/brown areas possibly indicating bare soil or other non-vegetated surfaces.
